Inspect every frozen diagnostic and turntable frame against references; silhouette, construction, proportions and materials must meet the brief. Features: Complete adult W. corrugata soft body and broad naked ventral creeping foot; not hollow armour or isolated scleritome; Eight transverse trunk rows plus paired anterior fan row, nine serial organizations under Zhang et al2015 interpretation; broad asymmetric dorsal, rounded upper-lateral, oval lower-lateral and narrow sickle ventrolateral scales overlap posteriorly; Two dorsolateral ranks of9 unequal flattened blade spines, shorter at ends, long parallel-sided proximal blades and tapering tips; no conical spikes or legs; Small anterior ventral mouth-supporting patch with two transverse rows of curved teeth; no external fanged jaw or annelid appendages. Scope: Evidence-informed WHOLE adult Wiwaxia corrugata exterior reconstruction, nominal50mm long not a measured specimen replica. Smith2014 documents eight transverse rows and anterior organization; Zhang/Smith/Shu2015 explicitly reinterprets anterior organization in W.corrugata as ninth serial row, based also on adult ROM57707. Model uses eight trunk rows PLUS anterior paired fan; it does not falsely assert both authors use identical counting or impose juvenile W.papilio proportions/spine absence.2015 correction2023 adds omitted dataset only, not retraction. Molluscan versus deeper lophotrochozoan affinity remains uncertain. Colors, exact posture, body depth and soft margins inferred. Fine rib count simplified; no internal gut simulation, fossil scan or copied mesh.

concept_decisions: Actual concept inspected. REJECT its large external terminal denture/jaw: instead small ventral-anterior supporting patch with two rows of small teeth tucked under anterior body. REJECT overregular equal scales and conical-looking thick spines: actual build differentiated scale zones, posterior overlap and flattened narrow blade spines of unequal length. Retain oval complete body and naked continuous underside. Eight trunk rows, per adult half-row3 dorsal+4 upper-lateral+1 lower-lateral+5 sickle ventrolateral scales; paired anterior fan is additional ninth organization.9 blade spines per side is within adult7–11 range. Use sparse raised longitudinal ridge relief as low-poly shorthand, NOT literal9–15 ribs. Large foot continuous and unsegmented, no legs/eyes/tentacles. Closed real volumes. Supplemental clean-import ventral diagnostic separate from exact8 canonical proof to expose foot and feeding apparatus.
